drhp.business: T.V. Today Network Limited is an India-based company in the media and entertainment industry, operating mainly in television broadcasting and other media operations. It runs four TV news channels - Aaj Tak, Aaj Tak HD, India Today TV and Good News Today - alongside 28 dedicated digital-first brands, and broadcasts news and current affairs across multiple platforms including television and digital media. Its major customers are advertisers (private, public, government and other entities advertising on its platforms) and viewers/subscribers of its channels and digital platforms.

risks.note: The Board's Report states that a large part of the Company's revenue continues to come from advertising, so demand is tied to advertiser spending rather than a diversified revenue base.

A market slowdown and reduced marketing spend by key industry players may lead to reduced advertising demand and may impact revenue growth; mitigated by reviewing strategic decisions and market trends, diversifying investment across multiple growth opportunities and pursuing new avenues and business deals.

Success of the news channels depends highly on viewership, brand position and the ability to innovate; with the emergence of new entrants, competition is described as a sustained risk. Mitigation rests on accurate and timely news delivery, brand investment, presence across all major Hindi-speaking markets and monitoring of viewership trends.

BRSR flags obsolescence of traditional workflows and formats from rapid adoption of AI-enabled production, overdependence on a few third-party platforms and algorithms affecting visibility, distribution control and monetisation stability, and capability gaps in adopting AI, automation and advanced analytics. Mitigated through intelligent automation, strengthening owned-and-operated platforms, and upskilling in AI and data.
risks.risk: Technology and innovation risk (AI-driven, platform-centric media)

risks.note: Risk of financial loss or disruption of operations from failure of IT systems, hackers gaining access to the website/platforms or sensitive data, and virus/malware/ransomware attacks; a data-security lapse could impact stakeholder trust, disrupt operations and cause regulatory or reputational consequences. Mitigated by ISO 27001 certification, Zero Trust architecture, encryption, backups, periodic vulnerability assessments, multiple security controls and a cyber insurance policy.

Any default may attract penal provisions and impact the Company's reputation, and the Company may face litigation from third parties by virtue of being in the news industry. Mitigated through a compliance monitoring system, in-house legal experts and external consultation, and continuous monitoring of regulatory changes.

BRSR material-issue table records that the fast-paced nature of the media industry exposes the workforce to significant health and safety risks, with negative financial implications; mitigated by group insurance, an in-house medical facility, hospital partnerships, wellness workshops and PPE.

Climate change may increase the frequency and severity of natural disasters, and companies with major/key operations concentrated at one place are at risk; mitigated by analysing disaster impact, planning protective measures and maintaining adequate insurance coverage.
risks.risk: Loss of assets or profit due to natural calamities and operational concentration
